##### Project general facts

The Berkeley is an elegant residential development that blends contemporary luxury with the tranquility of nature, offering a lifestyle inspired by the lush surroundings of Dubai Hills Park. Thoughtfully designed to create a sense of balance and well-being, the project features beautifully curated fully furnished residences with panoramic views of landscaped greenery. Combining sophisticated architecture with refined interiors, The Berkeley provides a peaceful urban retreat where comfort, style, and nature exist in perfect harmony.

Residents enjoy a lifestyle centered around wellness, relaxation, and everyday convenience. With direct access to the vibrant park environment and a carefully designed collection of premium amenities, the development encourages an active and balanced way of life. Its prime location within Dubai Hills offers seamless connectivity to major business districts, shopping destinations, dining venues, and leisure attractions, making it an exceptional choice for both homeowners and investors.

The residences are finished with premium materials and designer details, including bespoke Italian and European fixtures, EGGER woodwork from Germany, Bagno Design fittings from Italy, and exclusive finishes from Ilavio in Greece. Kitchens feature custom Snaidero cabinetry from Italy and are fully equipped with premium Bosch appliances. Every residence is delivered fully furnished with carefully curated interiors, creating a turnkey living experience that combines timeless elegance with modern functionality.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Hills is a prestigious and vibrant master-planned community located in the heart of Dubai. Developed by Emaar Properties in collaboration with Meraas Holding, it represents a harmonious blend of luxury living, natural beauty, and modern urban design.

At the heart of Dubai Hills is the stunning 18-hole championship golf course, designed to international standards. The golf course adds a touch of greenery and serenity to the landscape, attracting golf enthusiasts from around the world.

Dubai Hills is not just a residential development - it's a comprehensive lifestyle destination. The Dubai Hills Mall, a world-class shopping and entertainment center, offers an array of retail, dining, and entertainment options. Residents and visitors can also enjoy the Central Park, a vast expanse of greenery and relaxation.
